summary.headline: Critique of Astrology and Fate
summary.text: Critique of astrology and genethlialogy, distinguishing physical effects of stellar risings and settings on climate and medicine from astrological predictions of fortune, lifespan, and death. Galen, Hippocrates, the divine Fathers, John of Damascus, David, and Leo, archbishop of Thessalonica, are invoked in arguments about fate, free will, divine justice, and astrology.
